_doc: Employers whose job boards find_jobs.py queries. Seed this once during setup with target employers, then add to it whenever a new one turns up. `token` is the employer's slug in their careers URL; `ats` is one of greenhouse, lever, ashby, workable, smartrecruiters. Delete the examples.
_how_to_find_the_token: Search: <company name> greenhouse OR lever OR ashby jobs
Workday (myworkdayjobs.com) and Taleo have no open API. Those employers get searched by the agent directly, not here.
